reports.title: FICO Announces Earnings of $8.12 per Share

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: We are transitioning to bespoke mortgage originations pricing, tailored to the individual needs of our customers. One bespoke pricing program, the FICO Preferred Program, has had several deals already announced, and we continue to work with others on programs that will cover calendar-year 2027. At the same time, elevated interest rates and ongoing affordability challenges continue to weigh on the mortgage market, keeping loan originations below historical norms. We are in the middle of this pricing transition, where programs and agreements are still being finalized, and the outcomes of mortgage market challenges are uncertain. Because of these factors, we are not providing fiscal year 2027 guidance at this time.
